name: Glamour

components.pose: He stands relaxed but coiled, weight on one leg, head tilted slightly, an intense, knowing gaze toward the camera and a sly half-smile, sea wind stirring his hair.
components.wearing: close-fitting Deep Oceanic Blue-toned light leather armor, Seafoam Green accent straps across the chest and hips, built for silent movement; scale-like overlapping plates across the torso, a shell-shaped clasp at the collar
components.effects: A few droplets of water hang in the sea air around him, faint {{MAGIC}} light rippling softly through them - understated, nothing busy.

notes: Daily-post glamour shot: signature armor, coiled confident stance, element-matched background, light magic only.
